newsitem.title: USA: Ceco sees record Q4, annual net income.
newsitem.headline: Ceco sees record Q4, annual net income.

text.p: Ceco Environmental Corp said on Tuesday it expected to report record sales and net income for the fourth quarter, and record net income for the year ending December 31, 1996.
"Expectations are for continued new all time high records in 1997," the company said in a statement.
The company said it had booked $3.5 million in new filter contracts during the past week, including two U.S. Army contracts worth $3 million.

In the fourth quarter last year, the company had a net loss of $0.89 on revenues of $67 million. For the year ended December 31, 1995, it had a net loss of $0.22 on revenues of $265 million. In last year's fourth quarter, it earned $0.28 per share from continuing operations and it earned $0.77 per share from continuing operations in the full year.
The company also said rapid growth in its facilities management business caused it to incorporate a new subsidiary named Peek Facilities Management Inc.
